messages:
jamie: Quick followup from today's all-hands — a few asks on kernel decomposition, SLO alignment, and rollout cadence. TL;DR: teams need clarity on what kernel work will block Dedicated/Private timelines.

sara: Good call. We're tracking kernel v4 split into runtime-core, attention-opt, and mem-cache. Today only runtime-core is targeted for Q2 canary.

lee: To add, attention-opt has risky operator changes; we'll need model validation and perf baselines before canary.

mike: Ops question — will we get a stable ABI for sidecars? if not, Dedicated won't be able to pin images safely.

sara: Noted. Plan is: runtime-core ABI stable; attention-opt will use feature flags to avoid ABI changes. We'll publish draft ABI spec by next Wed.

anna: From product — customers asked for SLA targets on tail latency with batching enabled. Can we state SLOs we expect to hit per tier?

sara: Short answer: Hosted aims 95th < 120ms for 1k tokens in Q2; Dedicated baseline will be 95th < 200ms with autoscale. Those are soft until we run end-to-end benchmarks.

jamie: Can we get a matrix: kernel component -> expected risk -> blocker for Dedicated/Private -> owner? would help PM prioritization.

sara: Yes. I'll post a matrix in this thread tomorrow. Example row:
```
runtime-core | low | blocks Dedicated image pin | @sara
attention-opt | high | blocks Dedicated perf guarantee | @lee
mem-cache | medium | blocks cache warmup SLAs | @mike
```

devbot: Deploy scheduled: kernel-v4/runtime-core canary 1774210000 UTC. See CI run #4821

lee: Also, we should add a test that runs a 50k token replay to catch KV cache regressions before canary.

mike: Ops will add a pre-canary checklist: smoke test, 75th/95th latency run, eviction behaviour. I'll share template.

anna: Product asks for a communication plan for customers re: Dedicated pinning — could be a simple chown email + console banner during canary.

sara: Agreed. Action items: (1) matrix tomorrow (2) ABI draft Wed (3) ops checklist by Fri (4) perf runs next week. I'll create GH issues and ping owners.

jamie: Thanks! please @me on the GH issues. Also, let's capture canary rollback steps in the runbook so support can act fast if tail spikes. :eyes:

mike: Will do. Adding rollback commands and metrics thresholds to runbook.

sara: Posting initial matrix in #eng-runtime at 1774270000. Followups welcome.

jamie: Great. Closing the live thread — if anyone needs a slot in eng-sync to deep dive, ping me.

anna: :thumbsup:
